result.prior_version_note: As enacted by Ord. 25-057 (adopted May 21, 2025; Mayor approved May 22, 2025), § 218-12(2)(a) made it unlawful for any real estate lessor, agent, or subcontractor to "subscribe to, contract with, or otherwise exchange anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider." Ord. 25-076 (adopted July 16, 2025; Mayor approved July 17, 2025) added "or otherwise utilize", so mere use of a Service Provider's services is also prohibited. Neither ordinance states an effective date. A secondary source (DX06) lists the section only as "effective June 2025", so no exact first-application date can be fixed from the documents.
